title: The Theft of the Anathema of Vorus
author: Audrey Higgins

archive.primary: The Theft of the Anathema of Vorus.html

description: You are Sorse the Unwitting, a thief that lives up to the name. When your latest theft goes horribly wrong, you must correct the problems it has caused lest the world be wrought with pain and woe!
